items.title: 68426_Nellie Lutcher oral history interview
items.q: I went there to work with these two brothers from New York, the Daniel Brothers, William and Douglas Daniel.

ctx.x: Uh-huh. And was about to have more.

Oh, yes. Oh, Lord, yes, they were just coming in like crazy. So all of the spots -- San Diego was one of the hottest places in this whole area at that time, you see. And Long Beach, even Long Beach out here was a very hot spot. But San Diego was especially a hot place, you know. So anyway, I was with that group, and well, I guess we were together, I would say, about three years. And then later we sort of -- everybody sort of spread out. And then I went to -- that's when I went to the Club Royal. I went there to…
And the Club Royal was in Los Angeles.
